meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测药物分子怎样结合蛋白质
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在药物研发中需要判断化合物如何结合靶蛋白。
copy.tagline_en: Predict how drug molecules bind to proteins
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on drug discovery and need to see how small molecules bind to a target protein.

howto.what: 当用户请求分子对接时，Claude 会运行 DiffDock：输入蛋白质结构或序列和配体（SMILES/SDF/MOL2），输出预测的结合姿态文件并附置信度；不预测结合亲和力。
howto.when: 当用户要求做蛋白-小分子对接、预测结合姿态或虚拟筛选时触发（如说“对接这个配体”“筛选化合物库”），需提供蛋白PDB/序列和配体SMILES等。

say.text: 用 DiffDock 把这个配体对接蛋白 1abc.pdb，输出结合姿态。
say.note: 会生成姿态文件并标出置信度。

say.text: 用这个 CSV 批量对接做虚拟筛选，按置信度排序。
say.note: 会逐复合物运行并汇总排名结果。

say.text: 分析刚才结果的置信度，解释高、中、低区间怎么分。
say.note: 会读取分数区间并分类。

howto.what_en: When molecular docking is requested, Claude runs DiffDock: given protein structure/sequence and ligand SMILES/SDF/MOL2, it outputs predicted binding-pose files with confidence; it does not predict binding affinity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests protein-ligand docking, pose prediction, or virtual/batch screening, typically with a protein PDB/sequence and ligand SMILES/structure.

say_en.text: Dock this ligand to protein 1abc.pdb with DiffDock and rank poses.
say_en.note: Outputs pose files with confidence tags.

say_en.text: Run virtual screening batch docking from this CSV and score by confidence.
say_en.note: Processes each complex and aggregates results.

say_en.text: Analyze these confidence scores; how are high/moderate/low divided?
say_en.note: Reads scores and classifies by range.
